semantics: Client aggregator (bundle ld, kind Ft.ACADEMY='y'): active = sum of sizes of academies not busy and off landmark positions ('l' prefix); slots = sum size (size-1 while expanding). Apprentice slots unlock every Gu=5 academy levels: COO@5, CFO@10, CMO@15, CTO@20. A LVL1 academy correctly shows locked slots. The original client renders 'the specific impact is not documented' (Building.academyImpactNotDocumented) unconditionally - there is no numeric formula in the original. Apprentice starting skills: 50% (mPt) of relevant skill. Canonical server rules chosen (documented in code): +1 training skill point and starting-skill point per 5 active academy levels, max +2.
